## Description

Computes robust option hedging strategies by minimizing worst-case replication error over a Wasserstein ambiguity set of rough volatility sample paths generated via fractional Brownian motion.

## Where it may fit

Exotic options hedging, illiquid volatility derivatives portfolios, crash regimes with wide bid-ask spreads.

## Vehicles

Institutional Options Market Makers, Structured Products Desks.

## Required data

Option Greeks, implied volatility surfaces, spot underlying paths, fractional Hurst parameters.

## Caveats

Minimax robust optimization across rough volatility trajectories requires heavy GPU training.
